consistency_note: No coherent journey is possible: POV is zero in both orientations, and landscape train exterior is one 10 s overcast autumn clip of the M2 on the Halic bridge. Landmarks split into two looks: (a) clear summer golden-hour drone shots (Galata Tower 20 s, Hagia Sophia 9 s, plus the Galata Bridge hyperlapse 14 s, which is sped up) that match each other well; (b) the Eminonu sunset-to-night timelapse (28.5 s) and the Uskudar pier crowd shot (21.7 s, faces), which match neither (a) nor the overcast metro clip. The vertical set is larger (3 train clips, 5 landmark clips) but mixes underground pink-graded metro, grey winter montage and blue summer Bosphorus.
sourcing_note: Hard for trains, easy for landmarks. Worked: "Istanbul metro train bridge" (Halic bridge M2 clip), "Istanbul nostalgic red tram Taksim" (Istiklal tram, Tunel funicular), landmark names (Galata, Hagia Sophia, Maiden's Tower, Galata Bridge, Bosphorus return dozens, mostly drone and many vertical). "Istanbul tram Istiklal" first returned only /photo/ pages. Found nothing for: view from a tram/train/metro window, Marmaray train (only one unresolved vertical station clip), modern T1 tram at Sultanahmet/Eminonu/Karakoy/Galata Bridge, Kadikoy-Moda tram. Mislabel traps: a German museum tram, an Izmir seafront vehicle titled "Turkey", a Mexico City tourist trolley. Istiklal tram footage that resolved is vertical only; the one landscape Istiklal tram clip is 720p and untitled. TOOLING: fetch_pexels.sh failed to resolve every id above ~26,000,000 that was tried (0 of 21 across both cities) plus two older clips with nonstandard dimensions, so recent uploads could not be measured at all - the totals are a floor for landmarks, and newer train clips may exist unmeasured. pipeline/audit/sheet.sh crashes with this ffmpeg 6.1.1 (pad filter error on every clip), so frame sheets were made with an equivalent scratch script (4 frames per clip at 10/37/63/90%); the repo script was not modified. Steadiness is judged from stills, not from playback.
